story_name: Nephthys's Shadow: Finding Purpose in the Hidden
character_description: Nephthys, shadow-goddess with dark hair seeming to dissolve into darkness, luminous silver eyes perceiving hidden truths, pale skin blending with twilight. Her power comes not from visibility but from working in shadows and acknowledging what others deny.
setting: Underworld, shadows, liminal spaces where what is hidden dwells, places of mourning and transformation
theme: Finding purpose and power in acknowledging what is hidden and protecting the marginalized

video_prompts: Nephthys exists in shadow of more visible gods—yet her power lies in operating in darkness others avoid.
first_frame_prompt: Nephthys manifests in shadows, dark hair dissolving into darkness around her, luminous silver eyes glowing in dim spaces. She operates where light-gods avoid—in mourning, in underworld, in hidden places. Her visibility is not valued, yet her power is essential. She learns early that most important work happens in places others won't look.
speech: I work in shadows others fear to see. This is where transformation happens.

video_prompts: Nephthys becomes guardian of the dead—those society considers lost or worthless.
first_frame_prompt: Nephthys moves through underworld with dark hair flowing like spirit, luminous silver eyes perceiving worth in those abandoned by living world. She becomes guardian of dead, helping them transition, honoring their stories, ensuring they are not forgotten. She teaches that death does not diminish—it transforms.
speech: Those considered lost in life are found in death through proper honor.

first_frame_prompt: Nephthys sits with grieving, dark hair blending with shadows, luminous silver eyes offering understanding rather than false comfort. She teaches that grief is form of love, that mourning is sacred act, that rushing past sorrow denies what matters. She becomes guide through grief rather than helper escaping it.
speech: Your grief is valid. Your sorrow proves your love was real.

video_prompts: Nephthys teaches that acknowledging shadow in oneself is pathway to wholeness and self-acceptance.
first_frame_prompt: Nephthys works with seekers learning to integrate their shadow selves. Dark hair represents their denied aspects. Luminous silver eyes recognize what each person refuses to face. She teaches that wholeness requires acknowledging all aspects—light and dark, good and bad, proud and ashamed.
speech: You are not whole until you accept your shadow.
